device: iPhone 16 Pro (iPhone17,1) real device, iOS 27.0.1, 402x874 pt @3x, ProMotion; display link 120 Hz (CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone, preferredFrameRateRange 80..120 pref 120)
format: jsonl, one row per line. k=start {t, scene, rec, scale, maxfps, w, h}; k=touch {t, phase 0 began / 1 moved / 3 ended, x, y} (window points, UITouch.timestamp = CACurrentMediaTime clock); k=dl one row per CADisplayLink tick {t = link.timestamp, d = duration when not 1/120} - dl rows are kept only around gestures (0.15 s before touch-down .. 1.1 s after touch-up). Rows other than dl are logged only when a value changed, so a tick with a dl row and no other row means "nothing changed this tick". k=state {on | v, hl, tr} control state; k=evt {e valueChanged|touchDown|touchUpInside, v}; k=L control layer tree rows (p = sublayer index path from the control layer, c = layer/delegate class, x, y, w, h window bbox, bw, bh, a, sx, sy, tx, ty, cr, bg rgba, fill) to depth 2 (depth 1 in the multi-tap files); k=frame _UILiquidLensView (switch knob / slider thumb) with cls, id, lp, lpp, f_tx, flex targets and integrator as in lens; k=flex rows only in button scenes.
notes: Drag and fling files come from a second pass with 30 Hz path points (smooth). Flings faster than ~250 pt/s could not be synthesized: slider-w300-fling and -fling-medium arrive as one jump move then touch-up (the slider then animates to the lift-off point), switch-off-fling40 has 5 moves in 67 ms. Use them only as jump/teleport references, not for projection fits. The slider-ends pass (note on its captures) shows no catch-up at the ends: the value maps the finger by the full track width throughout, reaches an end with the finger leading the thumb by about 11 + 37 * (1 - start value) pt, and the track stretches only past that point (rubber band as fitted in the simulator, 13 / 0.74); on the way back the value moves again where it reached the end, with no re-basing.
